capabilities: Create and open daily notes from a sidebar icon
Roll over unchecked to-dos with their headings and structure
Schedule recurring to-dos with a cron-like {{obligate}} template macro
Link each note to the previous and next note via template macros
Archive old daily notes to keep the notes directory clean
extras: Points to an example template file and crontab.guru for macro syntax; offers help via GitHub issues.
intentEvidence: A fully featured replacement for the built-in daily notes plugin.
motivation: The author's to-do list was extensive with lots of formatting he wanted to maintain between notes, which rollover-daily-todos destroyed.
problem: The built-in Daily notes plugin starts each note blank, and rollover-daily-todos copies unchecked tasks into one heading, discarding the note's formatting structure.

relations.evidence: rollover-daily-todos copies only the unchecked to-do items and places them all into a specified header
Obligator replaces and extends the function of the built in Daily notes plugin

summary: Daily notes replacement that copies unchecked to-dos, their surrounding formatting, and scheduled items into each new daily note.
